name: paperwing-mfe
description: Paperwing frontend as micro-frontends: a thin shell plus Invoices and Time remotes over Module Federation.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shell,invoices,time -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/shell" "npm run dev -w apps/invoices" "npm run dev -w apps/timesheets"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/invoices -w apps/timesheets -w apps/shell
scripts.preview: concurrently -n shell,invoices,time -c blue,green,magenta "npm run preview -w apps/shell" "npm run preview -w apps/invoices" "npm run preview -w apps/timesheets"
